INSERT INTO daily_report_value ( id, report_id, field_id, field_code, field_name, field_type, value_text, value_number, value_date, value_json, sort_no, create_time, update_time ) VALUES
( #{item.id}, #{item.reportId}, #{item.fieldId}, #{item.fieldCode}, #{item.fieldName}, #{item.fieldType}, #{item.valueText}, #{item.valueNumber}, #{item.valueDate}, #{item.valueJson}, #{item.sortNo}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime} )
ON CONFLICT(report_id, field_code) DO UPDATE SET field_name = excluded.field_name, field_type = excluded.field_type, value_text = excluded.value_text, value_number = excluded.value_number, value_date = excluded.value_date, value_json = excluded.value_json, sort_no = excluded.sort_no, update_time = excluded.update_time
